title: catalyst identity whoami
description: Who catalyst-users says is signing (design 29, fw-IDENTITY-000002, -000008, -000010, -000011): the logged-in person, or with no one logged in this machine's system account; the userid the signers ledger gives them (null before their first signature); their groups and roles (shown by the roles template's names), their grants in this deployment (`cmd:<command>`, `reconcile:<level>`; every grant where they administer its criterion) and the reconciliation level those give; and the criteria they administer.

administers.description: the criteria (deployments' project names) catalyst-users says they administer, as a criterion-admin
